tagline: Where Jackson died, and down the old line of Route 14.
intro: Two roads make up this byway. Stonewall Jackson Road and Guinea Station Road run from SR 2 at Locks Corner toward US 1, by way of the old railroad stop at Guinea. The other, SR 721, follows the former line of SR 14 between US 360 at St. Stephens Church and US 301 near DeJarnette, through Newtown and Sparta.

Guinea was once spelled Guiney's, after an old county family, and its station stood on the Richmond, Fredericksburg and Potomac Railroad. After the Battle of Chancellorsville about four thousand captured Union soldiers were collected there.

moments.title: Guinea
moments.text: Lee had the wounded Stonewall Jackson moved back from the field hospital to Guiney's Station for safety, and Jackson died there on May 10, 1863.

moments.title: Newtown
moments.text: Newtown, in King and Queen County on the old SR 14 line, has a historic district listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
